result.summary: The page is largely well-designed, but one restaurant card (Tokumaru Ramen Bar) shows a broken/missing image placeholder, and a horizontal carousel item is clipped at the right edge without a clear scroll affordance.

issues.description: The 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card under 'Popular right now' displays a broken-image placeholder icon (grey box with crossed-out picture symbol) instead of an actual restaurant photo, while the card still shows a '€0 delivery' badge and a favorite button.
issues.suggestion: Load a real image for this restaurant; if the image fails to load, show a branded fallback (e.g., logo or colored placeholder with the restaurant name) instead of the generic broken-image glyph.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' horizontal carousel clips the third card ('Trattoria Piccol...') at the right screen edge with truncated title text and no visible scroll indicator, which can look like a layout bug.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle scroll affordance (e.g., partial-card peek with gradient fade or pagination dots) and ensure titles ellipsize gracefully so the cut-off looks intentional.

issues.description: The third carousel card's restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated mid-word without an ellipsis, reading as broken text.
issues.suggestion: Apply text-overflow ellipsis or wrap to two lines so truncated names are clearly abbreviated rather than cut off.
